description:
Is there any scriptural proof of guardian angels? Is there such a thing as getting rebaptized? Why are there so many religions? Watch now to find out.


Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 
By text: (618) 228-3975

QUESTIONS COVERED:

1.     I am divorced due to relationship issues & unfaithfulness from my ex-spouse. It has been about 3 yrs and I have not entered into a new relationship although I would like to find a new spouse. I do not want to live in sin. Is it acceptable to marry someone new, after divorce, without being considered an adulterer as referenced in Matthew 19:9? Is it acceptable to remarry after divorce? 

2.     1 Corinthians 10:8 says 23,000 fell in one day but Numbers 25:9 tells us that 24,000 fell. Is there a discrepancy between the two? Is there a discrepancy between 1 Corinthians 10:8 and Numbers 25:9?

3.   Can you please explain the rapture? 

4.      Years ago after being baptized as an Adventist, I drifted away from God. I am now making my way back to him and I am wondering if there is such a thing as getting rebaptized. Is there such a thing as getting rebaptized?

5.     Many people believe in guardian angels but is there any proof in scripture to support this? Is there any scriptural proof of guardian angels? 

6.     Should we be baptized in the name of the Father, Son, and Holy Ghost? No one in the Bible is baptized that way. See Acts 2:38 and Acts 19:5. Is not the name Jesus above every name?   

7. When we are born God gives us a soul and we are all children of God, our father. Is this correct? Are we all children of God? 

8.  There is only one God so Why are there so many religions? 

9.  Due to my age & health issues, I no longer participate in foot washing. However, I do participate in the rest of the Communion service. Is my partaking in Communion unworthy? 

10.  I have been trying to be a better Christian and not sin, but I know that I do sin and have sinned willfully and struggle daily not to sin. My question concerns Hebrews 10:26 and Hebrews 10:38. Am I then fruitless in my redemption because of an active choice I made? Am I beyond the Lord's mercy? 

11.  Who are the sons of God mentioned in Genesis 6? 

12.  When was the devil cast out from Heaven? Was it before or after the death of Christ on the cross?
